dataset.description: Residential population estimates per cell from JRC GHS-POP R2023A, reference epoch 2020. Population census / administrative totals from CIESIN GPWv4.11 are spatially disaggregated using corresponding GHSL built-up surface, volume and classification. Preserve fractional model counts; this is not people per square kilometre, an individual count, a live population measurement, WorldPop or a 2025/2030 projection.
